title: fix(objectql): a committed or rolled-back trio handle reads as closed
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb
Fixes #35149

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:脚本里手动开启的事务提交或回滚之后,仍带着这个旧事务的迟到写入会像普通写入一样正常落库,不再被塞进一个已经结束的事务。
- 为什么做:两种事务结束后的行为原本不一致,另一种早已按“已关闭即视为没有事务”处理,这次让两者一致。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某次迟到写入没有进入它本应加入的仍在进行的事务;改动只在事务已提交或已回滚之后生效,事务进行中的行为不变。
- 要你做什么:无,席位落地。

## 席位核对

### What changes

- `engine-execute-transactions.ts`: the trio's commit/rollback release is now `closeTrioTransactionScope`, which drops the owner record (as before) AND adds the handle to a module-level `closedTrioHandles` WeakSet, only for a handle the trio itself opened (one with an owner record). `isClosedTrioHandle` reads it. `recordTrioTransactionScope` clears the mark, so a driver that hands the same object out on a later `beginTransaction` gets it back open.
- `engine-transactions-section.ts` `isClosedUnitHandle`: when `openedUnits` holds no entry for the handle, it answers `isClosedTrioHandle(handle)`. An `openedUnits` entry still decides first, so a `transaction()` unit handle reads exactly as before.
- `engine-scoped-context.ts`: `commitTransaction` / `rollbackTransaction` call `closeTrioTransactionScope` in their existing `finally`. A joined (ambient) handle still returns early and is never marked.
- `engine.ts` untouched: 6852 lines at `origin/main` 921211960d and at head (facade ceiling 6854).
- Every reader of `isClosedUnitHandle` now treats a closed trio handle as absent, as #22855 does for a closed unit: `buildDriverOptions`, `enforceTransactionOrigin`, `opensAfterAbortUnit`, the secret-row release, the summary write transaction, and `openTransactionKind` (`'separate'` becomes `'none'` for a closed trio handle).
- Clause-② measured on the diff: no caller that got an answer now gets a refusal. A late write carrying a closed trio handle was never refused (unattributed handle, the gate declined to judge), and is not refused now; it runs unenrolled instead of being handed the dead handle.

### Tests

`packages/objectql/src/engine-transaction-same-origin.test.ts`:

- The PR #35102 pins "forgets the owner once the trio commits / rolls back" are re-worded to "treats the handle as closed once the trio commits / rolls back — a late cross-datasource write runs unenrolled". Intent kept (the record does not outlive the handle; the late write lands, not refused); the assertion now also requires `ledgerDb.writes[0].transaction` to be `undefined`.
- New top-level describe `a trio handle closes as a transaction() unit handle does (#35149)`, in the same harness file: parity with a closed `transaction()` unit handle on a late cross-datasource write; a late same-datasource write after rollback runs unenrolled; CONTROL (open trio handle reads open, enrolls, and a cross-datasource business write under it is still refused with `ERR_CROSS_DATASOURCE_TRANSACTION_WRITE`); `openTransactionKind` separate-then-none; a reused driver handle reads open on its next begin.

### Acceptance notes

- A0, reproduced at `origin/main` 921211960d source with the new tests only: a late `ledger` insert carrying a committed trio handle reached `ledger_db` with `transaction: { __trx: 'primary' }` (the dead foreign handle); the same after rollback. 7 failed / 27 passed.
- The ADR-0119 note (2026-11-18) says the owner record is "dropped when commitTransaction or rollbackTransaction closes it": still true, and its "a handle the engine never opened" limit now matches the code. No ADR edit.

- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor x1 → x0, blob abff61612cfc → 235b522e2582): close drops the record without marking → `Tests 7 failed | 27 passed (34)`; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (anchor x1 → x0, blob abff61612cfc → 99010386c306): `recordTrioTransactionScope` no longer clears the mark → `Tests 1 failed | 33 passed (34)` (the reused-handle pin); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
